arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE full-body polished hand-drawn cel-shaded Cartoon game sprite. Image1 is exact original pose/silhouette authority. Image2 is shared worker identity/style ONLY, do not copy its pose or orientation. Same adult miniature worker: simple close-fitting black cap and short dark hair, bright green long-sleeved shirt, royal blue bib overalls, dark navy work shoes, warm tan face and hands. Match key face/materials/outline weight. EXACT FRAME POSE: BACK VIEW walking away, back of black cap and neck visible, NO eye, nose, face or front bib pocket. Short passing step, one knee moving forward and the shoes overlap under the body. Image-right arm bent forward/out to the right at waist, opposite arm down/back. Back straps and back overalls visible. Preserve the original limb directions, leg bends, front versus back, overlaps and silhouette. Exactly two arms, two hands, two legs and two shoes; allow anatomically correct overlap. Do not add objects or change the pose to a generic walk. Smooth clean fills and restrained cel shading, crisp black ink contours. Source pixels are diagnostic colors, not stippling to reproduce. One isolated complete figure with ample transparent padding on every side on true transparent RGBA background. No scene, floor, shadows, glow, motion lines, lettering, border or sheet. Preserve alpha transparency.
